# Los Gatos Dispatch

> The Los Gatos Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Los Gatos, Monte Sereno, Saratoga and Campbell, CA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Los Gatos, Saratoga and Campbell](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Los Gatos, Saratoga and Campbell news](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Standards](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Downtown Los Gatos](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/downtown-los-gatos/): The Downtown Commercial Historic District on North Santa Cruz Avenue and West Main Street, with Town Plaza Park at their corner and the Civic Center at 110 East Main Street.
- [Almond Grove](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/almond-grove/): The Almond Grove Historic District, the town's first major subdivision after incorporation, with historic homes on Wilder, Tait, Bachman, Glen Ridge and Bean avenues near Santa Cruz Avenue.
- [Vasona and Oak Meadow](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/vasona-oak-meadow/): Oak Meadow Park at 233 Blossom Hill Road and the adjoining Vasona Lake County Park, linked by the Billy Jones Wildcat Railroad and its bridge over Los Gatos Creek.
- [Blossom Hill](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/blossom-hill/): Los Gatos east of Highway 17 along Blossom Hill Road, with the town's Blossom Hill Park and Belgatos Park, both reservable neighborhood parks.
- [North 40](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/north-40/): The North 40 Specific Plan area along Los Gatos Boulevard, about 44 acres bounded by Highway 85, Lark Avenue and Highway 17.
- [Monte Sereno](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/monte-sereno/): A 1.6-square-mile city west of downtown Los Gatos, with City Hall at 18041 Saratoga-Los Gatos Road and mountain slopes across its southern portion.
- [Saratoga Village](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/saratoga-village/): Historic Saratoga Village along Big Basin Way, with Blaney Plaza, the Saratoga Historical Museum in Historical Park on Saratoga-Los Gatos Boulevard and wooded Wildwood Park on 4th Street.
- [Saratoga Civic Center and Fruitvale](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/saratoga-civic-center/): Around Fruitvale and Saratoga avenues, with City Hall at 13777 Fruitvale Avenue, the Saratoga Library, the Heritage Orchard, the Joan Pisani Community Center and West Valley College.
- [Quito](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/quito/): Eastern Saratoga around Quito Road and Saratoga Avenue, with the 6.3-acre El Quito Park on Paseo Presada and its ball field, picnic areas and pickleball courts.
- [Downtown Campbell](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/downtown-campbell/): Historic downtown between Highway 17 and Winchester Boulevard, with the Downtown Campbell light rail station, the Campbell Historical Museum on North Central Avenue and the Ainsley House on Grant Street.
- [Pruneyard-Dry Creek](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/pruneyard-dry-creek/): East Campbell between Bascom and Leigh avenues, from Hamilton Avenue south to Dry Creek Road, with the 27-acre Pruneyard and its Mission Revival shopping center.
- [West Campbell](https://www.losgatosdispatch.com/west-campbell/): West of Winchester Boulevard toward San Tomas Expressway, with the Campbell Community Center at Winchester and West Campbell Avenue and John D. Morgan Park on Rincon Avenue.
